savollar.savol: "Give up" phrasal verb nima ma'noni anglatadi?
"Hand in" nima ma'noni bildiradi?
Matnda "belong to" so'zi qanday kontekstda ishlatilgan?
"End up" nima ma'noni anglatadi?
Matnda "rely on" so'zi qaysi misolda ishlatilgan?
"Show off" nima ma'noni bildiradi?
variantlar: Odamlarga ta'sir qilish uchun ko'z-ko'z qilmoq

savollar.savol: Matndagi iqtiboslar bo'limida Warren Buffettning iqtibosi qaysi mavzuga tegishli deb berilgan?
Shekspirning "A light heart lives long" iqtibosi qaysi mavzuga oid deb ko'rsatilgan?
Matnga ko'ra, past IQ ko'rsatkichiga ega odamlar nimaga erishishlari mumkin?
variantlar: Shaxsiy sadoqat va tizimli harakat orqali muvaffaqiyat

savollar.savol: "Write up" nima ma'noni bildiradi?
"The singer has never ___ trying to do his best." Qaysi phrasal verb bo'shliqqa mos keladi?
"I couldn't finish the crossword puzzle and had to ___ and look at the answers." Qaysi so'z to'g'ri?
"The rules of the sport were ___ early in the nineteenth century." Qaysi phrasal verb mos keladi?
"She ___ all her school friends when she went to university." Qaysi phrasal verb mos tushadi?
"The boxer ___ in the first round." Qaysi phrasal verb mos tushadi?
"These books belong to the college library, so you can ___." To'g'ri javobni tanlang.
"If Madina keeps coming to work late, she'll end up ___." To'g'ri javobni tanlang.
"After we'd boarded the plane, the stewardess handed out ___." To'g'ri javobni tanlang.
"Sandra realised she'd left her passport behind, so she ___." To'g'ri javobni tanlang.
"After we'd eaten our meal, we asked the waiter for ___." To'g'ri javobni tanlang.
Matnga ko'ra, nega ba'zi yuqori IQ'ga ega odamlar muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraydi?
variantlar: Motivatsiya yetishmasligi, xarakter, dangasalik yoki qisqa diqqat tufayli

savollar.savol: Matndan qanday asosiy xulosa chiqarish mumkin?
variantlar: Muvaffaqiyat har doim aql darajasining ko'rsatkichi emas

savollar.savol: "Paul has worked out a way to ___." Matndagi "work out" so'zining ma'nosiga mos javobni tanlang.
Nazira va Akrom o'z qizlarini kim nomi bilan atashgan va bu qanday phrasal verb orqali ifodalangan?
Matnda keltirilgan iqtidorli sportchi (gifted athlete) misoli nimani ko'rsatish uchun ishlatilgan?
variantlar: Iqtidor bo'lsa ham, tizimli harakat bo'lmasa, yaxshi natija bermasligini

savollar.savol: "A newspaper relies on the honesty and accuracy of ___." To'g'ri javobni tanlab, bu nimani anglatishini aniqlang.
Matnga ko'ra past IQ darajasi o'zgartirilishi mumkinmi?
variantlar: Ha, ongli tanlov va harakat orqali o'zgartirilishi mumkin

savollar.savol: Lailah Gifty Akitaning "The action you will take today, will define tomorrow" iqtibosi qaysi mavzuga tegishli va nega?
variantlar: Kelajak rejalari, chunki u bugungi harakat ertangi kunni belgilashini aytadi

savollar.savol: "The accident investigator wrote up his final report on the fire after he had ___." To'g'ri javobni tanlang.
variantlar: yong'in haqidagi qaydlarini ko'rib chiqqandan keyin

savollar.savol: Matn mazmuniga ko'ra, muvaffaqiyat ko'proq nimaga bog'liq deb xulosa qilish mumkin?
variantlar: Tizimli harakat, motivatsiya va shaxsiy sadoqatga
